attribute.name.blightcaller.curse_durati: Your curses last longer. Each curse deals its damage for more seconds before it runs out.
blightcaller.configuration.curse_display: How you see curses on mobs, also without Jade. Only for you.
blightcaller.configuration.curse_hud_row: Curse Row at the Health Bars Box

Row of curses with seconds at the mob box of Health Bars (only with Health Bars). Above the name / below the health: in the box, in line with the name. Above / below the box: outside it. Automatic: below the health for a box at the top of the screen, else above the name.
blightcaller.configuration.curse_icon_ra: Range in blocks for the curse icons above the head.
blightcaller.configuration.curse_icon_se: Remaining seconds in the corner of the curse tiles above the head (look Detailed). Hidden while a tile is too small on the screen.
blightcaller.configuration.curse_icon_si: Size of the curse icons above the head in percent (100 = as large as before).
blightcaller.configuration.curse_icon_st: Detailed: the curse icon as a tile that turns grey from the top as the curse runs out, with the remaining seconds. Simple: a small symbol with a ring that runs down.
blightcaller.configuration.curse_icons.t: Small curse icons above the head that show their remaining time. Your own curses are bright with a violet frame, those of other players pale.
blightcaller.configuration.curse_icons_w: Keep the curse icons above the head while Jade is installed (Jade shows the details of one mob, the icons give an overview).
blightcaller.configuration.curse_tick_fl: A cursed mob flashes red on every curse tick. Only for you.
blightcaller.configuration.curse_tick_so: A cursed mob plays its hurt sound on every curse tick. Only for you.
blightcaller.configuration.curse_ticks.t: Feedback of the damage curses deal every second. Real hits always flash and sound.
blightcaller.configuration.curse_veil.to: A faint violet veil over cursed mobs, stronger with every curse level (pulsing at level 3).
blightcaller.configuration.drain_soul_to: A see-through copy of the target is torn out of its body at every pulse and drawn to you.
blightcaller.configuration.title: Blightcaller Configuration
commands.blightcaller.curse.apply.done: Cursed %s with %s for %s s: %s damage per tick (power %s x factor %s)%s
commands.blightcaller.curse.info.entry: - %s from %s: %s per tick%s, %s s left, next tick in %s s, %s so far
commands.blightcaller.curse.not_a_curse: %s is not a curse (mob effect tag #blightcaller:curses)
death.attack.blightcaller.curse.player: %1$s withered away under the curse of %2$s
effect.blightcaller.enfeeble.description: Takes more damage from all sources. A curse without damage of its own.
effect.blightcaller.gravebind.descriptio: Ghostly chains hold the target: it moves much slower, also in the air. A curse without damage of its own.
effect.blightcaller.pestilence.descripti: Takes soul damage every second and spreads the plague to enemies nearby.
effect.blightcaller.soul_rend.descriptio: The soul is torn open by Drain Soul. A curse without damage of its own.
effect.blightcaller.soul_rot.description: Takes soul damage every second for a long time.
item.blightcaller.spell_book/blightcalle:
Spell Book of Blightcallers, cursing foes with soul magic that rots them over time
- Strengths: Damage over time, weakening, strong against tough enemies and bosses
- Weaknesses: Slow start, little burst damage, very low defense
- Equipment: Lightly armored
skill.blightcaller.boost.title: Blight Attunement
skill.blightcaller.class_lock.blocked: Locked: you already follow another class.
skill.blightcaller.class_lock.info: Cannot be combined with another class.
skill.blightcaller.class_lock.toast.blig: You already follow another class. Blightcaller cannot be combined with it.
skill.blightcaller.class_lock.toast.clas: You already follow the Blightcaller path. It cannot be combined with another class.
skill.blightcaller.moved.class: Blightcaller is now part of the Class Skills tab. Nodes reset in the Blightcaller tab: %s. Their points can be spent again.
skill.blightcaller.moved.conflict: You took another class in Class Skills while Blightcaller had its own tab. Blightcaller nodes reset in Class Skills: %s.
skill.blightcaller.moved.own: Blightcaller has its own tab again. Blightcaller nodes reset in Class Skills: %s. Their points can be spent again.
skill.blightcaller.moved.weapon: Hex Bolt and Blight Burst nodes were removed from Weapon Skills: %s. Their points can be spent again.
skill.blightcaller.root.title: Path of Blight
skill_category.blightcaller.blightcaller: Soul magic: curses that eat away at foes over time and pass from one to the next.
spell.blightcaller.blight_burst.descript: Launches a ball of blight that bursts on impact, causing {damage} soul spell damage and setting Soulburn on all enemies within {impact_range} blocks.
spell.blightcaller.blight_burst.name: Blight Burst
spell.blightcaller.blightbloom.descripti: When an enemy with at least one of your curses dies, it bursts and puts Soulburn on all enemies within {bloom_range} blocks ({soulburn_damage} soul damage per second for {soulburn_duration} seconds, Curse Duration adds to that). Enemies that die of it burst as well.
spell.blightcaller.blightbloom.name: Blightbloom
spell.blightcaller.coup_de_grace.descrip: Enemies below {coup_health} health take {coup_bonus} more damage from your curses (ticks and Last Rites), bosses too.
spell.blightcaller.coup_de_grace.name: Coup de Grace
spell.blightcaller.deep_drain.name: Deep Drain
spell.blightcaller.deep_frailty.descript: Enfeebled targets take {frailty} more damage instead of {frailty_base} (bosses {frailty_boss}).
spell.blightcaller.deep_frailty.name: Deep Frailty
spell.blightcaller.deepening_rot.descrip: Your curses with damage tick {rot_per_tick} harder with every tick on the same target, up to {rot_max} from the {rot_ticks}th tick on. Refreshing a curse keeps the count, a curse that runs out starts again.
spell.blightcaller.deepening_rot.name: Deepening Rot
spell.blightcaller.drain_soul.descriptio: Channels a stream that tears the soul out of the target, dealing {damage} soul spell damage and healing you by {heal} every second. Tears the soul open with Soul Rend.
spell.blightcaller.drain_soul.name: Drain Soul
spell.blightcaller.enduring_chains.descr: Gravebind lasts {effect_duration_add} seconds longer. Curse Duration adds to that.
spell.blightcaller.enduring_chains.name: Enduring Chains
spell.blightcaller.enervation.descriptio: While your Enfeeble lasts, the target deals {enervation} less damage with every attack (bosses {enervation_boss}). Several Blightcallers do not stack.
spell.blightcaller.enervation.name: Enervation
spell.blightcaller.enfeeble.description: Curses the target with Enfeeble, making it more vulnerable to all damage. Deals no damage itself.
spell.blightcaller.enfeeble.name: Enfeeble
spell.blightcaller.gravebind.description: Ghostly chains burst from the ground around you, causing {damage} soul spell damage to all enemies nearby and binding them with Gravebind.
spell.blightcaller.gravebind.name: Gravebind
spell.blightcaller.hex_bolt.description: Hurls a bolt of hex, causing {damage} soul spell damage and setting Soulburn on the target.
spell.blightcaller.hex_bolt.name: Hex Bolt
spell.blightcaller.improved_enfeeble.des: Enfeeble lasts {effect_duration_add} seconds longer. Curse Duration adds to that.
spell.blightcaller.improved_gravebind.de: Gravebind reaches {range_add} block further: {gravebind_range} blocks instead of {gravebind_base}.
spell.blightcaller.improved_last_rites.d: Last Rites deal {rites_bonus} more damage per curse level instead of {rites_base}.
spell.blightcaller.improved_pestilence.d: Pestilence reaches {carriers} carriers per cast instead of {carriers_base}.
spell.blightcaller.infectious_curses.des: Each cast of a curse spell has a {infect_chance} chance to put its curse on one more enemy within {infect_range} blocks of the target, with the same power and duration. It spreads no further. With Pestilence the extra carrier takes a place in its chain.
spell.blightcaller.last_rites.descriptio: Speaks the last rites over all enemies around you, detonating your curses on them.
spell.blightcaller.last_rites.name: Last Rites
spell.blightcaller.lingering_rend.descri: Soul Rend lasts {effect_duration_add} seconds longer after the channel. Curse Duration adds to that.
spell.blightcaller.lingering_rend.name: Lingering Rend
spell.blightcaller.pestilence.descriptio: Curses the target with Pestilence, a plague that rots its soul and spreads to enemies nearby.
spell.blightcaller.pestilence.name: Pestilence
spell.blightcaller.rapid_contagion.descr: Pestilence spreads every {contagion_interval} seconds instead of every {contagion_base}. The first spread still comes after {first_spread} s.
spell.blightcaller.rapid_contagion.name: Rapid Contagion
spell.blightcaller.soul_echo.description: Last Rites put a fresh Soulburn on every enemy whose curses they detonated ({soulburn_damage} soul damage per second for {soulburn_duration} seconds, Curse Duration adds to that).
spell.blightcaller.soul_echo.name: Soul Echo
spell.blightcaller.soul_migration.descri: When an enemy with your curses dies, your curses pass with their remaining time to the nearest enemy within {migration_range} blocks. Each curse passes on at most {migration_jumps} times.
spell.blightcaller.soul_migration.name: Soul Migration
spell.blightcaller.soul_rot.description: Curses the target with Soul Rot, rotting its soul for a long time.
spell.blightcaller.soul_rot.name: Soul Rot
spell.blightcaller.soulfire_chains.descr: Gravebind also puts Soulburn on every bound enemy ({soulburn_damage} soul damage per second for {soulburn_duration} seconds, Curse Duration adds to that).
spell.blightcaller.soulfire_chains.name: Soulfire Chains
spell.blightcaller.spreading_rot.descrip: Soul Rot also takes hold of the nearest other enemy within {spread_range} blocks of the target, with the same power and duration. It spreads no further.
spell.blightcaller.spreading_rot.name: Spreading Rot
spell.blightcaller.swift_rites.descripti: The cooldown of Last Rites is {cooldown_duration_deduct} seconds shorter.
spell.blightcaller.swift_rites.name: Swift Rites
spell.blightcaller.tenacious_rot.descrip: Soul Rot lasts {effect_duration_add} seconds longer. Curse Duration adds to that.
spell.blightcaller.tenacious_rot.name: Tenacious Rot
spell.blightcaller.vengeful_hex.descript: When an enemy hits you, it is enfeebled for {hex_duration} seconds (Curse Duration adds to that). The modifiers of Enfeeble do not apply.
spell.blightcaller.vengeful_hex.name: Vengeful Hex
spell.blightcaller.weapon_blight_grimoir: Blight Burst hits enemies within {burst_range} blocks instead of {burst_base}.
spell.blightcaller.weapon_blight_root.de: Hex Bolt and Blight Burst deal {power_multiplier} increased damage.
spell.blightcaller.weapon_blight_wand.de: Hex Bolt deals {focus_bonus} more damage per curse level of the target instead of {focus_base} (at curse level 3: {focus_max} instead of {focus_max_base}).
spell.blightcaller.wide_contagion.descri: Pestilence reaches new carriers up to {contagion_range} blocks further away: {spread_range_new} blocks instead of {spread_range_base}.
spell.blightcaller.wide_contagion.name: Wide Contagion
spell.tooltip.blightcaller.curse_damage: %1$s: %2$s soul damage per second for %3$s s (%4$s in total).
spell.tooltip.blightcaller.curse_level_b: +%1$s damage per curse on the target, up to %2$s curses.
spell.tooltip.blightcaller.curse_mark: %1$s: lasts %2$s s after the last hit, no damage of its own, counts as a curse.
spell.tooltip.blightcaller.curse_slow: %1$s for %2$s s: the target moves %3$s slower (bosses %4$s).
spell.tooltip.blightcaller.curse_spread: Every %1$s s each carrier infects an enemy within %2$s blocks that has no Pestilence, up to %3$s carriers per cast (the target included). Copies keep the remaining time.
spell.tooltip.blightcaller.curse_weaken: %1$s for %2$s s: the target takes %3$s more damage from all sources (bosses %4$s).
spell.tooltip.blightcaller.last_rites: Detonates your own curses with damage: the damage of their next %1$s s × %2$s at once, then they are gone. Curses of other players and curses without damage stay.
